env GOPROXY=off
mkdir $WORK/bin

# The generated MarshalJSON of an eligible struct reaches no reflect code:
# a dependency that only exposes it builds with transitive_reflect denied.
cd ok/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE
stdout '^\{"name":"a","n":3\}$'
cd ../..

# A dependency that must use reflect for an interface field fails the same deny.
cd bad/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/bad$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_reflect\]'
stderr 'example\.com/nrdep'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|exec|net)'
cd ../..

-- ok/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nrmain

go 1.27

require example.com/nrdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/nrdep => ../dep

-- ok/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"

-- ok/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nrdep"
)

func main() {
	out, err := dep.Item{Name: "a", N: 3}.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

-- ok/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/nrdep

go 1.27

-- ok/dep/dep.lgo --
package dep

type Item struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	N    int64  `json:"n"`
}

-- bad/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nrmain

go 1.27

require example.com/nrdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/nrdep => ../dep

-- bad/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"

-- bad/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nrdep"
)

func main() {
	out, err := dep.MarshalWild(dep.Wild{Note: "x", Payload: 7})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

-- bad/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/nrdep

go 1.27

-- bad/dep/dep.lgo --
package dep

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
)

type Wild struct {
	Note    string `json:"note"`
	Payload any    `json:"payload"`
}

func MarshalWild(w Wild) ([]byte, error) {
	if reflect.TypeOf(w.Payload) == nil {
		return json.Marshal(struct {
			Note string `json:"note"`
		}{w.Note})
	}
	return json.Marshal(w)
}
